content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "If Service Canada cannot give you a SIN, you can ask the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) for a temporary tax number (TTN) to file your return and apply for benefits [s10-c500-001]. Newcomers can apply for benefit payments before they file their first tax return, using form RC151 or form RC66 [s10-c500-000]. A new resident without children applies with form RC151, or online through the CRA web form [s10-c500-000]."}
